product_one_liner.value: SpotDraft is an AI-native contract lifecycle management platform that helps in-house legal teams create, review, negotiate, sign, store, and track contracts.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing information describes flexible plans and included services; numeric prices are not published.

hq_location.notes: Uses the headquarters explicitly stated on the company website; LinkedIn instead lists New York.

eng_blog.notes: Engineering-authored posts cover the front-end Nx monorepo migration and Bazel-based ML build/deployment workflows.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Open title: Product Manager - AI; owns extraction accuracy, agent runtime, and AI governance. This is an AI product role, not an ML engineering or data-scientist title.

model_provider.value: GPT-4 hosted on Microsoft Azure Enterprise; also supports GPT-4o, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and Bison.
model_provider.notes: The VerifAI FAQ identifies GPT-4 as primary and the others as supported alternatives.

compliance_certs.notes: These are the company’s public certification/compliance claims; HIPAA and GDPR are compliance frameworks rather than standalone certifications.

raised_18mo.notes: The January 27, 2026 funding announcement falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Account Executive - APAC posting; the open board also lists US account executive and sales development representative roles.

launched_6mo.notes: SpotDraft announced its Claude connector on October 29, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026; it enables access to contract libraries, metadata, approvals, and other contract workflows from Claude.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On December 3, 2025, SpotDraft announced Alon Waks as Chief Marketing Officer and Amit Sharma as Chief Financial Officer, within the requested 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Sales Operations explicitly owns Salesforce CRM. Marketing hiring names Google Search and LinkedIn Ads campaign management and HubSpot familiarity. HubSpot and Zoho are also named product integrations, not independently proven internal CRM deployments.
